Authors: Wenxuan Shen, Dongna Jin, Dongping Chen

NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation Manipulation

monocular scene reconstruction procedural programming physics-in-the-loop embodied simulation MLLM code synthesis

简要说明：NeoWorld-Pro 利用多模态大语言模型将单张 RGB 图像转化为交互式 3D 仿真场景的程序化表示，并通过物理引擎反馈迭代优化，支持堆叠与精细操作等具身智能下游任务。

TLDR: NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into physically interactive 3D simulation scenes by using MLLMs to generate procedural programs and a physics-in-the-loop mechanism for refinement, enabling downstream embodied tasks like stacking and manipulation.

Abstract: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.

摘要（中文）：具身智能的进步需要能够忠实反映真实世界的高质量仿真资源。然而，由于当前图像到URDF的转换方法缺乏物理基础与场景级交互性，将原始视觉观测转化为可直接用于仿真的场景仍具挑战。我们提出NeoWorld-Pro框架，该框架将单目场景重建重新定义为面向交互式三维环境的程序化编程。借助多模态大语言模型的零样本推理与代码合成能力，NeoWorld-Pro可将单张RGB图像转化为可执行程序，并精确指定物体几何结构、关节运动方式及物理属性。通过物理在环机制，系统在物理引擎中验证程序执行效果，迭代优化所生成的程序，确保关节运动符合物理规律、物体组合与交互有效合理、空间关系准确无误。实验表明，NeoWorld-Pro性能优于开环方法与现有单目重建技术，并能支撑稳定堆叠与精细操作等复杂下游任务。

Authors: Yumeng He, Yichen Song, Xiaotian Yang, Weijia Zhang, Zanwei Zhou, Junru Gong, Xiaokang Yang, Yunbo Wang

Platonic Representation Hypothesis on World Models WorldModel

Platonic Representation Hypothesis Predictive Consistency Assumption World Models DINO-WM model stitching

简要说明：本文在世界模型中实证验证了柏拉图式表征假说，表明通过优化预测一致性目标，异质模型会收敛到相似的潜在表示，几何对齐和功能拼接实验提供了证据。

TLDR: This paper empirically validates the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within world models by showing that diverse models optimizing a predictive consistency objective converge to similar latent representations, as evidenced by geometric alignment and functional stitching in the DINO-WM framework.

Abstract: World models have demonstrated significant potential for perceiving and simulating complex environments. Despite their strong performance, the fundamental nature of their learned representations remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within this domain by proposing the Predictive Consistency Assumption: we posit that the optimization of a shared state transition objective acts as a selective pressure that encourages heterogeneous models to converge toward a shared latent structure. Through systematic experiments with the DINO World Model (DINO-WM), in which we vary visual encoders to create heterogeneous models, we find that capable world models evolve toward geometrically similar internal structures. Moreover, via model stitching, we show that the internal features of one world model can be mapped to another with limited performance degradation, providing evidence of functional compatibility. Our findings suggest that the pursuit of predictive consistency can promote shared, transition-compatible latent structure across world models.

摘要（中文）：世界模型在感知与模拟复杂环境方面展现了显著潜力。尽管其性能强劲，但所学表征的基本性质仍鲜为人知。本文通过提出预测一致性假设（Predictive Consistency Assumption）来探究该领域内的柏拉图表征假说（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）：我们假定，对共享状态转移目标的优化会产生一种选择性压力，促使异质模型向共享的潜在结构收敛。通过对DINO世界模型（DINO-WM）开展系统实验——实验中通过改变视觉编码器构建异质模型——我们发现，能力足够的世界模型会演化出几何相似的内部结构。此外，通过模型拼接（model stitching）实验，我们证明一个世界模型的内部特征可映射至另一模型且性能下降有限，这为功能兼容性提供了证据。我们的研究结果表明，追求预测一致性能够促进世界模型间形成共享的、与状态转移兼容的潜在结构。

Authors: Wenhow Li, Chengwei MA, Hui Xiong, Ying-Cong Chen, Lei Zhang

WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation RLRobot

off-policy RL massively parallel simulation data-regime-aware sample weight decay sim-to-real

简要说明：WarpSAC 提出了一种基于数据规模自适应调节稳定器的离策略强化学习算法，在 GPU 并行操作和 sim-to-real 迁移上取得了显著提升。

TLDR: WarpSAC proposes regime-aware off-policy RL algorithms that adapt stabilizers to data availability, achieving large improvements in GPU-parallel manipulation and sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighting improves learning efficiency across regimes, especially with limited network capacity. Based on these findings, we propose WarpSAC, a regime-aware family of off-policy RL algorithms. WarpSAC uses Sample Weight Decay for efficient exploitation and provides two variants: WarpSAC-L (Norm ON, clipped double-Q) for data-limited CPU-scale training, and WarpSAC-A (Norm OFF, single-Q) for data-abundant GPU-parallel training. WarpSAC improves normalized score--step AUC over FlashSAC by 4.5% across nine CPU-scale environments and 23.1% across fourteen GPU-parallel environments. It increases UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 success rate from 19.8% to 96.4%, improves mean normalized wall-time AUC on MuJoCo Playground by 19.1%, and achieves 36.4% faster sim-to-real deployment on Unitree G1 than FlashSAC. These results show that scalable off-policy RL should adapt its stabilizers to the available data regime.

摘要（中文）：大规模并行仿真改变了离线策略强化学习（RL）的训练数据模式，对专为数据有限回放设计的稳定器提出了挑战。通过在八个基准族上开展受控实验，我们表明这些稳定器具有数据模式依赖性：参数归一化有助于狭窄的回放覆盖，但在数据充足时会限制价值拟合；而裁剪双Q在吞吐量较高的操作中可以放宽。基于年龄偏置的回放加权在多模式下均能提升学习效率，尤其当网络容量受限时。 基于这些发现，我们提出WarpSAC——一种感知数据模式的离线策略RL算法族。WarpSAC采用样本权重衰减实现高效利用，并提供两种变体：面向数据有限CPU尺度训练的WarpSAC-L（开启归一化、采用裁剪双Q），以及面向数据充足GPU并行训练的WarpSAC-A（关闭归一化、采用单Q）。WarpSAC在九个CPU尺度环境下将归一化得分-步累计面积较FlashSAC提升4.5%，在十四个GPU并行环境下提升23.1%；将UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1成功率从19.8%提升至96.4%，在MuJoCo Playground上改善平均归一化墙钟时间累计面积达19.1%，并在Unitree G1上实现比FlashSAC快36.4%的仿真到现实部署。这些结果表明，可扩展的离线策略RL应使其稳定器适配可用数据模式。

Authors: Zihao Wu, Hongyao Tang, Yi Ma, Huizhong Song, Pengyi Li, Yifu Yuan, Fei Ni, Jinyi Liu, Wei Wei, Jianrong Wang, Yan Zheng, Jianye Hao

Fiber Bragg Grating Whiskers for Bioinspired Hydrodynamic Perception on Underwater Robots Other

fiber Bragg grating whiskers bioinspired hydrodynamic perception underwater robot vortex detection passive sensing

简要说明：本文提出了用于水下机器人的仿生光纤布拉格光栅触须，能够实现被动水动力感知，并通过触须信号单独完成流速传感、涡流检测和导航决策。

TLDR: This paper presents bioinspired fiber Bragg grating whiskers for underwater robots that enable passive hydrodynamic perception, demonstrating flow sensing, vortex detection, and navigation decision-making from whisker signals alone.

Abstract: Harbor seals track hydrodynamic trails with their vibrissae, enabling passive perception of moving targets in dark or turbid water. Inspired by this capability, we present compact fiber Bragg grating (FBG) whiskers for underwater robots. Like seal whiskers, they have a non-uniform taper and elliptical cross-section. Controlled towing experiments show a monotonic relative-flow response from 0.1 to 0.6 m/s, a strong reduction of self-induced oscillation relative to a cylindrical baseline, and a pronounced dependence on angle of attack. Experiments with a pitching foil show that the whiskers can detect the characteristic vortices shed by a stationary or moving source, detectable several seconds after the source has passed. Using this information, a single front-mounted whisker enabled a small underwater robot to distinguish between continuing straight and executing a turn, selecting the correct branch in 17 of 20 trials (85.0%) from whisker signals alone. These results connect bioinspired hydrodynamic sensing to robot action and suggest the utility of whiskers for tracking underwater objects.

摘要（中文）：斑海豹依靠其触须感知水动力尾迹，从而能够在黑暗或浑浊水域中被动探测运动目标。受此能力启发，我们为水下机器人研制了紧凑型光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）触须。与海豹触须相似，此类传感器具有非均匀锥形截面和椭圆横截面。受控拖曳实验表明：其在0.1至0.6米/秒流速范围内呈现单调相对流响应、相较于圆柱基准结构可显著抑制自激振荡，且对攻角具有明显依赖性。俯仰翼型实验显示，该触须能探测静止或运动源脱落的特征涡旋，甚至在源通过后数秒仍可检测到涡旋信号。基于此信息，单个前置触须即可使小型水下机器人区分直线航行与转向动作——在20次试验中，仅凭触须信号，机器人有17次（85.0%）正确选择了分支路径。这些研究结果将仿生水动力感知与机器人行为决策相衔接，揭示了触须传感器用于水下目标追踪的应用潜力。

Authors: Hao Li, Tianyu Tu, Siyue Yao, Ziyang Chang, Juhyun Jung, Xiaochi Xie, Long Yin Chung, Tian-Ao Ren, Genliang Chen, Mark Cutkosky

Bridging Teacher Expectations and Robot Learning via Coupling Dynamics Manipulation

human-robot teaching coupling dynamics mental model mismatch robot learning teaching effectiveness

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于人类教师与机器人学习者之间耦合动力学的新尺度来分类人机教学交互，并分析了心理模型不匹配对教学效果的影响。

TLDR: This paper proposes a new scale to classify human-robot teaching interactions based on coupling dynamics between human teachers and robot learners, and analyzes mismatches in mental models to improve teaching effectiveness.

Abstract: Human-robot teaching focuses on enabling nontechnical experts to customize robots according to their needs after deployment. With recent advances in machine learning, human-robot teaching is no longer confined to offline learning where the data gathering step from a human teacher is separated from when the robot learns. Instead, more recent approaches for human-robot teaching focus on coupling human teaching with robot learning. This coupling impacts the structure, timing, and content of the teaching and learning interaction. However, it is currently unclear how such coupling dynamics affect humanrobot teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process. Informed by human learning theories, in this paper we propose a new scale for classifying human-robot teaching interactions according to coupling dynamics present between the human teacher and robot learner. We apply this scale to a subset of the human-robot teaching literature to identify how coupling dynamics and human teacher mental model mismatches with the ground truth robot learning system affect teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process

摘要（中文）：人机教学旨在使非技术专家能够在机器人部署后，根据自身需求对其进行定制。随着机器学习的最新进展，人机教学不再局限于离线学习——即人类教师的数据采集步骤与机器人的学习过程相分离。相反，近年来的人机教学方法更注重将人类教学与机器人学习相结合。这种结合影响了教学与学习互动的结构、时机和内容。然而，目前尚不清楚这种结合动态如何影响人机教学的有效性以及人类对教学过程的感知。受人类学习理论的启发，本文提出了一种新的分类尺度，用于根据人类教师与机器人学习者之间的结合动态对人机教学互动进行分类。我们将该尺度应用于人机教学文献的一个子集，以识别结合动态及人类教师心理模型与机器人真实学习系统之间的不匹配，如何影响教学有效性及人类对教学过程的感知。

Authors: Evan Dallas, Sean Dallas, Wing-Yue Geoffrey Louie

Safety-aware Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Signal Temporal Logic Other

MPPI control barrier functions Signal Temporal Logic safety-aware motion planning receding-horizon control

简要说明：本文提出一种基于采样的滚动时域规划框架，通过将信号时序逻辑约束编码为时变控制障碍函数并集成到MPPI控制器中，在火星车和四旋翼飞行任务中实现了安全高效的运动规划。

TLDR: This paper presents a sampling-based receding-horizon planner that integrates Signal Temporal Logic constraints via time-varying control barrier functions into an MPPI controller, achieving safe and efficient motion planning for Mars Rover and quadcopter tasks.

Abstract: Safety-aware motion planning remains a challenge in robotics, especially when missions are time-critical and are under complex specifications. In this paper, we propose safety-aware-stl-mppi, a computationally efficient sampling-based receding-horizon planning framework designed to promote satisfaction of constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). Our approach encodes discrete-time STL formulas into candidate time-varying control barrier functions (CBF), which are integrated into a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller. Our method inherits the benefits of low computational cost from an efficiently parallelizable sampling based planner and utilizes CBF for constraints expressed in STL. We compare against several MPPI baselines using four artificial Mars Rover planning case studies with a diverse environment and cost setups, where we show our method consistently achieving high safety and efficiency. We show a quadcopter planning experiment with NVIDIA Isaac Lab.

摘要（中文）：安全感知的运动规划仍是机器人领域的一项挑战，尤其在任务对时间敏感且需满足复杂规格要求的场景中。本文提出了一种名为safety-aware-stl-mppi的计算高效型采样滚动时域规划框架，旨在提升对信号时序逻辑（STL）约束的满足能力。该方法将离散时间STL公式编码为时变控制屏障函数（CBF），并将其集成至模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器中。该框架继承了基于采样的可高效并行规划器的低计算成本优势，并利用CBF处理STL表示的约束。通过四项包含不同环境与成本设置的仿真火星车规划案例研究，我们与多个MPPI基线方法进行了对比，结果表明所提方法能持续实现高安全性与高效率。此外，我们还展示了基于NVIDIA Isaac Lab的四旋翼无人机规划实验。

Authors: Yiqi Zhao, Taekyung Kim, Hideki Okamoto, Bardh Hoxha, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Lars Lindemann, Georgios Fainekos

Interpreting Control Latents for System Identification via Conditional Flow Matching RLRobot

latent-conditioned adaptive policies conditional flow matching system identification predictive tuning robustness analysis

简要说明：本文提出了一种方法，利用条件流匹配将自适应机器人策略中的潜在表示解码为物理四旋翼模型分布，从而在不修改策略的情况下实现预测性调优和鲁棒性分析。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method using conditional flow matching to decode latent representations from adaptive robot policies into distributions of physical quadrotor models, enabling predictive tuning and robustness analysis without modifying the policy.

Abstract: Latent-conditioned adaptive policies can control robots across changing dynamics, but their learned latents remain internal representations of the policy rather than physical models that can be inspected, rolled out, or used by other control modules. This limits closed-loop analysis, diagnosis, and further improvement of a fixed policy. A direct mapping from latent to physical parameters is also under-specified, because multiple systems can induce similar closed-loop behavior. We therefore decode each operational latent into a distribution of quadrotor models using conditional flow matching. The decoded distribution enables two downstream uses without modifying the policy: online predictive tuning of a high-level controller around the fixed low-level policy, and robustness analysis under specified disturbances. Under perturbed actuator dynamics, decoded-model predictive tuning reduces position tracking RMSE by $23\%$ and heading RMSE by $45\%$ relative to fixed gains. Under Gaussian force disturbances, decoded-model ensembles closely predict the lateral tracking-error evolution. Together, these results show that control latents can be converted into physical model ensembles for tuning, robustness analysis, and diagnosis of frozen adaptive policies.

摘要（中文）：隐条件自适应策略能够控制机器人应对变化的动力学特性，但其学习的隐变量仍作为策略的内部表征，而非可被检查、执行或由其他控制模块使用的物理模型。这限制了固定策略的闭环分析、诊断及进一步改进。由于多个系统可能产生相似的闭环行为，从隐变量到物理参数的直接映射存在欠定性问题。因此，我们利用条件流匹配将每个运行时的隐变量解码为四旋翼模型的分布。解码后的分布能够在无需修改策略的情况下实现两种下游应用：围绕固定底层策略对高层控制器进行在线预测性调优，以及指定扰动下的鲁棒性分析。在作动器动力学受扰条件下，与固定增益相比，基于解码模型的预测性调优使位置跟踪均方根误差降低23%，航向角均方根误差降低45%。在高斯力扰动条件下，解码模型集成能够精确预测横向跟踪误差的演化。这些结果表明，控制隐变量可转化为物理模型集成，用于冻结自适应策略的调优、鲁棒性分析与诊断。

Authors: Dingqi Zhang, Ruiqi Zhang, Mark W. Mueller

Resilience Matters for Embodied Agents System: New Metrics, Systematic Evaluation, and Optimization Other

resilience evaluation embodied agents perturbation recovery metrics suite process-level assessment

简要说明：本文提出了一个针对具身智能系统的新韧性评估框架，定义了回弹、稳定性和优雅扩展性指标，以捕捉传统结果指标无法体现的动态恢复过程，并在家居任务中展示了其诊断与优化价值。

TLDR: This paper proposes a new resilience evaluation framework for Embodied Agent Systems, defining metrics for Rebound, Stability, and Graceful Extensibility to capture dynamic recovery processes not reflected in traditional outcome metrics, and demonstrates its diagnostic and optimization value across household tasks.

Abstract: Embodied Agents System (EAS) are increasingly deployed in open-world physical domains, where reliability directly dictates deployment quality and human-agent trust. However, existing evaluations rely on outcome-centric metrics as success rate or safety scores that collapse diverse execution trajectories into coarse scores, obscuring the dynamic processes underlying agent behavior. Therefore, they ignore a critical property of EAS -- which we define as the Resilience -- that reflects how EASs recover, stabilize, and extend under perturbations and across iterative updates. The lack of resilience is particularly critical in open-world environments due to continuous unexpected disruptions, thus directly affecting the quality of EAS deployment. To address this problem, we gain insight from the resilience-engineering concepts to EAS groundings and propose a novel resilience evaluation framework that can be flexibly applied to any EAS. Specifically, we define the first comprehensive resilience metrics suite for EASs system that exposes Rebound, Stability, and Graceful Extensibility across embodied tasks execution, providing a practical grounding for EAS resilience analysis. We further implement the resilience evaluation layer that transforms execution process into assessments for diagnosis and optimization. Across 400 household tasks with 10 EAS, we reveal the process-level distinction hidden by outcome metrics, including recovery cost differences among successful episodes ($ΔC_{rec}=25.2$), increased instability and task-family degradation. Metrics-guided optimizations reduce recovery cost and increase stability, graceful extensibility completion, showing the diagnostic effect of resilience evaluation. Our results reveal a trade-off among resilience characteristics, suggesting that a resilient EAS construction should be configured according to deployment-specific requirements.

摘要（中文）：具身智能体系统（EAS）正越来越多地部署于开放世界物理域中，其可靠性直接决定部署质量与人机信任度。然而现有评估依赖成功率、安全分数等结果导向型指标，将多样化的执行轨迹压缩为粗略评分，遮蔽了智能体行为背后的动态过程。因此，这些评估忽视了EAS的关键属性——我们将其定义为韧性——反映系统在扰动与迭代更新中恢复、稳定及延展的能力。在开放世界环境中，由于持续突发的干扰，韧性缺失问题尤为严峻，直接影响EAS部署质量。为解决该问题，我们从韧性工程理念中汲取灵感，将其映射至EAS基础架构，并提出可灵活应用于任何EAS的新型韧性评估框架。具体而言，我们首次为EAS系统定义了综合韧性度量体系，涵盖具身任务执行中的回弹、稳定性与优雅延展性，为EAS韧性分析提供了实用基础。进一步地，我们实现了韧性评估层，将执行过程转化为面向诊断与优化的评估指标。通过对10个EAS完成400个家庭任务的实验，我们揭示了被结果指标掩盖的过程级差异，包括成功回合间的恢复成本差异（ΔC_rec=25.2）、稳定性下降及任务族退化等现象。基于度量引导的优化降低了恢复成本，提升了稳定性与优雅延展性完成度，验证了韧性评估的诊断效能。研究结果揭示了韧性特征间的权衡关系，表明韧性EAS的构建应依据部署特定需求进行配置。

Authors: Yapeng Liu, Yuanzhao Zhai, Xudong Gong, Dawei Feng, Bo Ding, Lin Wang, Huaimin Wang

Primate vision reveals a missing principle for robust dynamic AI WorldModel

predictive world models object recognition motion integration primate vision robust dynamic AI

简要说明：比较灵长类视觉与AI模型在鲁棒动态物体识别中的表现，发现预测世界模型最匹配灵长类IT区并能跨外观泛化，但尚无模型复现从外观到运动编码的皮层转变。

TLDR: Compares primate vision and AI models on robust dynamic object recognition, finding that predictive world models best match primate IT and generalize across appearance changes, but no model replicates the cortical shift from appearance to motion coding.

Abstract: How does an intelligent visual system combine what objects look like with how they move while remaining robust as appearance changes? We addressed this question by comparing human perception and neural activity in macaque inferior temporal cortex with representations from image- and video-based neural networks spanning recognition, segmentation, optic-flow processing and predictive world modeling. Temporal integration improved object representations, but most video recognition models generalized poorly when appearance was disrupted while motion structure was preserved. Humans and macaque IT remained robust. Notably, predictive world models combined strong cross-appearance generalization with the closest correspondence to IT, outperforming other video-modeling approaches in neural fidelity. Yet no model reproduced the cortical transformation from early appearance-dominated responses toward later appearance-invariant motion coding. These results identify progressive integration of motion into object representations as a principle of robust dynamic vision and implicate predictive learning as a promising route toward realizing this computation in artificial systems.

摘要（中文）：智能视觉系统如何在物体外观变化时，仍能将物体的外观特征与其运动方式相结合并保持鲁棒性？我们通过比较人类感知、猕猴下颞叶皮层神经活动，与基于图像和视频的神经网络（涵盖识别、分割、光流处理及预测性世界建模）的表征，对这一问题进行了研究。时间整合改善了物体表征，但大多数视频识别模型在外观被破坏而运动结构保持不变时，泛化能力较差。人类和猕猴下颞叶皮层则保持鲁棒。值得注意的是，预测性世界模型在跨外观泛化方面表现强劲，且与下颞叶皮层的对应关系最为密切，在神经保真度上优于其他视频建模方法。然而，没有模型能够复现从早期以外观主导的反应，向后期外观不变的运动编码的皮层转变。这些结果表明，将运动逐步整合到物体表征中是鲁棒动态视觉的一个原则，并预示预测性学习是实现人工系统中该计算的有前景的途径。
